patch.summary: Move removed Stripe field reads to their documented new locations and update the pinned Stripe API version.
warnings: Subscription periods are read through a generated helper: the old subscription-level field when present (old-version events), otherwise the period every item shares, otherwise the item the application already selects or the configured price policy. Webhook endpoints are not changed.
The stripe package is not upgraded. TypeScript projects may need the stripe package version matching the new API version before they typecheck.
Patch contains source code. Review it for sensitive content before sharing.
